subtitle: When Chronicles Fall Silent and Songs Speak

panels.shot: wide, dusk-lit composition of Joymoti Konwari standing alone on a riverbank, dark forest and distant palace silhouettes behind her, sky heavy with storm clouds
panels.action: Joymoti Konwari stands barefoot at the edge of a misty river, her face calm and resolute as dark clouds gather over the distant Ahom palace and the shadowy Naga Hills frontier.

dialogue.text: In a kingdom of chronicles and courts, Joymoti Konwari stands between what history records and what Assam refuses to forget.

i18n.hi: इतिहास की अदालतों के बीच, जयमति कुन्वरी खड़ी है—जहां लिखा इतिहास खत्म, और असम की याद शुरू होती है।

panels.shot: epic bird's-eye view of the Brahmaputra valley, jungles and rivers snaking past moated towns and temple spires
panels.action: A sweeping view of the lush Brahmaputra valley shows flooded fields, thick forests, moated Ahom towns and smoke rising from distant settlements.

dialogue.text: Late seventeenth century Assam: the Ahom kingdom spreads along the Brahmaputra, its power old, its court shaken by suspicion and fear.

i18n.hi: सत्रहवीं सदी का आखिर, असम। अहोम राज ब्रह्मपुत्र के साथ फैला, राजपुरा पुराना, दरबार शक और डर से थरथराता।

panels.shot: interior wide of the Ahom royal court at Rangpur, courtiers divided into tense clusters around an empty throne
panels.action: Inside a timber-pillared hall, nobles in layered Assamese garments stand in uneasy groups around a high wooden throne draped in white cloth.

dialogue.text: The Tungkhungia Buranji speaks of a court in crisis, of kings replaced and restored, and of nobles who fear each other more than any outside enemy.

i18n.hi: तुङखुङिया बुरंजी कहती है—दरबार संकट में, राजा बदलते और लौटते, और ऐेसे सरदार जो बाहर के दुश्मन से कम, एक-दूसरे से ज़्यादा डरते हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot of anxious nobles whispering, a scroll of royal orders unfurled between them
panels.action: Two senior nobles lean over a palm-leaf scroll bearing royal orders, their faces tight as others watch from the shadows.

dialogue.text: In these troubled years, one name appears again and again in the chronicles: Gadapani, a prince forced into the forests to save his life.

i18n.hi: इन्हीं अशांत बरसों में एक नाम बार‑बार लौटता है—गदापानि, वो राजकुमार जो जान बचाने जंगलों में धकेल दिया गया।

panels.shot: dynamic wide shot of a small party slipping into dense forest, palace lights distant behind them
panels.action: A small group of armed men in simple tunics moves quickly into the dense forest edge, a faint glow of palace lights shrinking behind them under the night sky.

dialogue.text: The Buranji tells us plainly: Gadapani fled. A rival ruler hunted him. The prince vanished into the forests and the hill frontiers, beyond the court’s reach.

i18n.hi: बुरंजी साफ लिखती है—गदापानि भागा। प्रतिद्वन्द्वी राजा ने उसे शिकारी बनाया। राजकुमार जंगलों, पहाड़ी सरहदों में गुम हो गया, दरबार की पकड़ से दूर।

panels.shot: intimate interior mid-shot of Joymoti Konwari seated in a modest raised bamboo house, listening to distant drums, face thoughtful
panels.action: Inside a raised bamboo house, Joymoti Konwari sits by a small oil lamp, her hands still as she listens to the faint beat of war drums in the distance.

dialogue.text: The chronicles mention his wife, unnamed, left behind when he escaped. Songs and stories later give her a name: Joymoti Konwari.

i18n.hi: इतिहास उसकी पत्नी का ज़िक्र करता है, बिना नाम के, वही जो उसके भागते ही पीछे छूट गई। गानों‑कहानियों ने बाद में उसे नाम दिया—जयमति कुन्वरी।

panels.shot: close-up on Joymoti’s face, half in lamplight, half in shadow, eyes reflecting both fear and resolve
panels.action: Joymoti Konwari’s face fills the frame, one side lit by the lamp, the other swallowed in shadow, her gaze steady and unblinking.

dialogue.text: Here the river of evidence splits. The Buranji stays spare and dry. Assamese memory fills the banks with colour, tears, and unshaken resolve.

i18n.hi: यहीं गवाहियों की नदी दो धार हो जाती है। बुरंजी सूखी, नपी‑तुली। असम की याद किनारों को रंग, आँसू और अडिग हिम्मत से भर देती है।

panels.shot: wide shot of Ahom soldiers approaching Joymoti’s rural homestead at Jerenga Pathar, dust rising behind them
panels.action: Armed Ahom soldiers stride into a clearing at Jerenga Pathar, their spears catching the sun as Joymoti Konwari steps out of her house to meet them.

dialogue.text: The court, desperate, turns on the women left behind. The chronicle records that the prince’s wife suffered for his escape.

i18n.hi: हताश दरबार पीछे छूटी औरतों पर टूट पड़ता है। इतिहास बस इतना लिखता है—राजकुमार की बीवी ने उसके भागने की सज़ा झेली।

panels.shot: medium shot of Joymoti standing straight before a stern officer, wind tugging at her veil
panels.action: Facing a stern officer in court attire, Joymoti Konwari stands tall in the open field, her veil stirred by the wind but her chin lifted.

dialogue.speaker: joymoti_konwari
dialogue.text: A kingdom that fears its own princes is already weak.

i18n.hi: जो राज अपने ही राजकुमारों से डरता है, वो पहले से ही खोखला है।

panels.shot: somber wide shot by a riverside or clearing, Joymoti watched over by a small guard, distant hills and forest suggesting the Naga frontier
panels.action: By a quiet riverside at the edge of a forest, Joymoti Konwari sits under a tree guarded by two soldiers, while the hazy line of distant hills hints at the Naga frontier.

dialogue.text: Later tales dwell on her pain, on many days of torment. The Buranji simply says she was punished, that she endured in her husband’s absence.

i18n.hi: बाद की कहानियाँ उसके दर्द पर ठहरती हैं—तड़प के कई दिन। बुरंजी बस कहती है—उसे दंड मिला, और उसने पति की गैरहाज़िरी में सब सहा।

panels.shot: close-up of Joymoti’s clasped hands resting calmly in her lap, hint of rope bindings but no graphic detail
panels.action: Joymoti Konwari’s hands rest calmly in her lap, loosely bound with rope, her fingers relaxed rather than stiff with fear.

dialogue.text: Assam’s songs add what the court record does not dare to: a woman who refuses to speak, whose silence shields a hunted prince.

i18n.hi: असम के गीत वो जोड़ते हैं, जो दरबारी दस्तावेज़ कहने की हिम्मत नहीं करते—एक औरत जो चुप रहती है, जिसकी ख़ामोशी शिकारी राजकुमार को ढाल देती है।

panels.shot: extreme close-up on Joymoti’s eyes looking slightly upward, sky reflected in them
panels.action: An extreme close-up frames Joymoti Konwari’s eyes as she looks up, the blue-grey sky reflected in their calm surface.

dialogue.speaker: joymoti_konwari
dialogue.text: If I yield, the river of our house runs dry.

i18n.hi: मैं झुक गई, तो हमारे घर की नदी सूख जाएगी।

panels.shot: low-angle wide of Gadapani in disguise emerging from dense forest on a hillside, distant view, showing his exile
panels.action: On a hillside path, a lone man in rough clothes and a bamboo hat steps from the dense forest, the valley and distant palace faint below him.

dialogue.text: Meanwhile Gadapani survives in exile, hiding in villages and frontier hills. The Buranji notes his path carefully; the court always feared his return.

i18n.hi: उधर गदापानि बनवास में बचता रहा—कभी गाँवों में, कभी सरहदी पहाड़ों में छिपकर। बुरंजी रास्ता गिनती है; दरबार को उसकी वापसी का हमेशा डर था।

panels.shot: transition wide shot of storm clouds over Rangpur palace, lightning faintly illuminating its outline
panels.action: Dark storm clouds roll over the Ahom palace at Rangpur, a flash of lightning briefly etching its sloping roofs and watchtowers in white.

dialogue.text: Then everything shifts. The crisis at court deepens. The rival king’s hold weakens, and the prince in the shadows senses his moment.

i18n.hi: फिर सब करवट लेता है। दरबार का संकट गहराता है। प्रतिद्वन्द्वी राजा की पकड़ ढीली होती है, और साया बना राजकुमार अपना वक़्त भाँप लेता है।

panels.shot: dynamic bird’s-eye of assembled Ahom forces and nobles in a field near the capital, preparing to acclaim a new ruler
panels.action: In a broad field near the capital, ranks of soldiers and nobles gather in ordered lines, drums poised, eyes turned toward a raised platform.

dialogue.text: In 1682, the chronicles say, Gadapani returns with support, overthrows his rival, and takes the name Gadadhar Singha, founding a new line of kings.

i18n.hi: १६८२—बुरंजी कहती है, गदापानि सहारा जुटाकर लौटता है, प्रतिद्वन्द्वी को गिराकर गदाधर सिंघा बनता है, राजाओं की नई धारा शुरू करता है।

panels.shot: low-angle mid shot of Gadadhar Singha seated on the Ahom throne, courtiers bowing, with emphasis on the restored stability
panels.action: Gadadhar Singha sits firmly on the Ahom throne, his shoulders broad, as rows of courtiers bow before him in the lamplight of the royal hall.

dialogue.text: For the court record, this is the triumph: a strong monarch restores order, disciplines nobles, rebuilds the kingdom’s shaken spine.

i18n.hi: दरबार के लिए यहीं जीत है—एक सख्त राजा लौटकर अनुशासन थोपता है, सरदारों को साधता है, डगमगाते राज की रीढ़ फिर खड़ी करता है।

panels.shot: gentle wide shot of a village gathering at Jerenga Pathar decades later, elders and children around a storyteller, Joymoti’s figure imagined in the background
panels.action: Under a large tree at Jerenga Pathar, villagers sit in a circle around an elder storyteller, while in the background a faint, imagined image of Joymoti Konwari stands by a riverbank.

dialogue.text: For the village and the song, the triumph lies elsewhere: in the memory of a woman who stood firm so a future king could live.

i18n.hi: गाँव और गीत के लिए जीत कहीं और है—उस औरत की याद में, जो अटल खड़ी रही, ताकि आने वाला राजा ज़िंदा रहे।

panels.shot: medium shot of a modern-era Assamese playwright at a desk, lamplight over manuscripts titled with Joymoti’s name, with Joymoti’s serene figure faintly behind him
panels.action: In a later century, a modern Assamese writer bends over a lamplit desk stacked with manuscripts, while a translucent image of Joymoti Konwari seems to watch from behind.

dialogue.text: Modern writers and filmmakers take her further, shaping Joymoti into a patriotic emblem, a mother of the nation for a new Assam being imagined.

i18n.hi: आज के लेखक‑फिल्मकार उसे और आगे ले जाते हैं—जयमति को देशभक्त चिन्ह बनाते, नए कल्पित असम की ‘माँ’ बनाते हैं।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide of Joymoti standing by the Brahmaputra at sunrise, palace and village both tiny on the horizon
panels.action: At sunrise, Joymoti Konwari stands again by the wide Brahmaputra, the distant palace and a small village both reduced to tiny silhouettes on the far bank.

dialogue.text: Between the bare lines of the Buranji and the rich weave of memory, Joymoti Konwari teaches us that we can honor courage and still ask what the record truly says.

i18n.hi: सूखी बुरंजी की पंक्तियों और यादों की गुँथी चादर के बीच, जयमति कुन्वरी सिखाती है—हम साहस का मान कर सकते हैं, और फिर भी पूछ सकते हैं कि दस्तावेज़ सच में क्या कहता है।

title_i18n.en: Joymoti and the Silence History Remembers
title_i18n.hi: जयमति और वो सन्नाटा जिसे इतिहास याद रखता है

subtitle_i18n.en: When Chronicles Fall Silent and Songs Speak
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब इतिहास चुप पड़े, गाने बोल उठते हैं
